p1: In 1985, LA's most feared killer came home... and saw his own face on every newspaper.
They called him the Night Stalker.
For over a year, he crept into homes at night, through unlocked doors and windows.
Then a witness wrote down the plate of his car.
Inside it, police found one fingerprint.
It matched a man named Richard Ramirez.
His photo went out on TV and in the papers.
He came back from Arizona, and his own face was staring back at him.
A woman saw him and screamed, "The killer!"
He ran. He tried to steal a car, and a crowd held him down until police arrived.
It wasn't the police who caught the Night Stalker. It was his neighbours.
Convicted of 13 murders, he said, "See you in Disneyland."
He died in prison in 2013. Never executed.
